title: Q-Compare: An Interactive Empirical Laboratory for Comparing Classical, Bayesian, and Quantum-Inspired Decision Models
description: Q-Compare is an interactive web application and analysis toolkit for benchmarking classical, Bayesian, and quantum-inspired models of human decision making against empirical order-effect and context-effect datasets. It includes model-fitting code, a leave-one-order-out cross-validation module, sensitivity analysis over evidence geometry, and a dashboard for comparing model fit (AIC/BIC, accuracy, calibration).
